name: Kasey
source:
Our main character. She’s a quiet girl who spends a lot of her time in the library. Despite her solitude, Kasey isn’t the shy type, but just hasn’t found her group of friends. She’s a very selfless girl in truth and tries to help others if needed. However, at times she may say the wrong thing, as she’s not the best when it comes to social situations. Often daydreams as well. Like books, video games, and fantasy worlds.
